title: While in edit mode, ESC key doesn't do anything if the pointer is over a Panel widget
line: Pressing Escape in edit mode now leaves edit mode even while the pointer is over a panel widget.
explanation: While the Panel Settings dialog is open, hovering a panel widget shows a popup (Remove/Configure/Show Alternatives) that activates itself and takes keyboard focus. Its content item never had focus, so the Escape handler added in 2025 never ran, and it only tried to close the popup anyway; Escape therefore did nothing. The content item now gets focus and Escape leaves edit mode, which also closes the panel settings.

commits.message:
containments/panel: leave edit mode on Escape over a widget handle

The popup shown over a hovered widget in edit mode takes keyboard focus,
but its content item had no focus and only tried to close the popup, so
Escape did nothing. Give it focus and make Escape leave edit mode.

BUG: 508269

Subject: [PATCH] containments/panel: leave edit mode on Escape over a widget
 handle

The popup shown over a hovered widget in edit mode takes keyboard focus,
but its content item had no focus and only tried to close the popup, so
Escape did nothing. Give it focus and make Escape leave edit mode.

BUG: 508269
---
 containments/panel/ConfigOverlay.qml | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/containments/panel/ConfigOverlay.qml b/containments/panel/ConfigOverlay.qml
index 5d7acc74a7..3009769f4e 100644
--- a/containments/panel/ConfigOverlay.qml
+++ b/containments/panel/ConfigOverlay.qml
@@ -332,9 +332,10 @@ MouseArea {
             hoverEnabled: true
             onEntered: hideTimer.stop();
             onExited:  hideTimer.restart();
+            focus: true
 
             Keys.onEscapePressed: {
-                tooltip.close()
+                Plasmoid.containment.corona.editMode = false
             }
 
             ColumnLayout {

media.caption: Edit mode with Panel Settings open, pointer over the Task Manager: its handle popup is shown
After pressing Escape twice: nothing changed, still in edit mode
One Escape press leaves edit mode

review.text: Correct cause: the hover popup takes keyboard focus but its content item had no focus, and its Escape handler only closed the popup. Giving it focus and leaving edit mode on Escape is a two-line QML change and matches what Escape does over the panel's own edit handle. Regressions in the dialog and the Configure button were checked.
